segments.title: Your keyboard is a trackpad
segments.say: Your iPhone keyboard is secretly a trackpad.

segments.title: Hold the space bar
segments.say: Touch and hold the space bar until the keyboard turns light gray.

segments.title: Now slide your finger
segments.say: Now slide your finger to move the cursor anywhere.

segments.title: No more tapping the typo
segments.say: No more stabbing at the exact letter to fix a typo.

segments.title: It's in Apple's own guide
segments.say: It's in Apple's own iPhone user guide.
